subject: [video] lead ruling: qp 0 reaches the rate control unchanged
body: WP03: pass the caller's n2avc_config to n2avc_rc_open as given (do not normalise qp before it). Meaning of qp 0: with bitrate > 0 the rate control picks the first QP from bits per pixel (WP04's table); with bitrate == 0 it means constant QP 26. Everything else in n2avc.h stands. Also WP03: fix the ASan overflow WP05 reported in n2avc_mb.c before anything else -- the phone payload waits on a clean WP03+WP05 run. Phone news for all: stage 0 ran. Stock VideoToolbox loads our plug-in (probe process and mediaserverd), Apple's software HEVC encoder registered by it encodes (30 frames 640x480 -> 110 kB) but slowly (350 ms/frame at 640x480, 900 ms at 1080p), there is NO working H.264 encoder on the phone (create ok, first frame -12908), so n2avc is the critical path. Speed matters: aim for real time at 720p.
